Cross-artifact broadening is stronger at workflow layer than at metric layer.

Same-family intermediate and optional states are usable review categories with threshold guardrails.
Aggregation taxonomy is viable at coarse level; fine thresholds are non-canonical.
Behavioral profile distinctions are meaningful in current bounded panel.

research_only_claims: Routing-confusability behavioral non-transfer as a broad rule.
Collapse-vs-contamination as a cross-context law beyond current merge-facing evidence.
